name: BRANCH-immediate-delete-saved-internal-P6-conflict
note: Conditional timing reading, not unconditional inconsistency; §9.5 explicitly protects saved-owner objects

formulae.P6.surviving_owner:

                          p0_created_x_itself,
                          p0_needs_x),
                      p0_executes_x_internally),
                   Or(And(p1_described_at_creation,
                          p1_created_x_itself,
                          p1_needs_x),
                      p1_executes_x_internally)),
                Not(Or(root_records_x, personal_records_x))),
            Or(Or(And(Or(Or(And(p0_described_at_creation,
                                p0_created_x_itself,
                                p0_needs_x),
                            p0_executes_x_internally),
                         p0_needs_x),
                      p0_in_current),
                  And(Or(Or(And(p1_described_at_creation,
                                p1_created_x_itself,
                                p1_needs_x),
                            p1_executes_x_internally),
                         p1_needs_x),
                      p1_in_current)),
               Or(And(Or(Or(And(p0_described_at_creation,
                                p0_created_x_itself,
                                p0_needs_x),
                            p0_executes_x_internally),
                         p0_needs_x),
                      p0_in_saved),
                  And(Or(Or(And(p1_described_at_creation,
                                p1_created_x_itself,
                                p1_needs_x),
                            p1_executes_x_internally),
                         p1_needs_x),
                      p1_in_saved)))),
        And(present, Not(deleted)))
